epistemic_standards.VERIFIED: Checked against production code, frozen artifacts, or reproducible simulation outputs.
epistemic_standards.INFERRED: Logically follows from verified facts but not directly measured as an isolated single-variable counterfactual.
epistemic_standards.UNSUPPORTED: Hypotheses, uncalibrated parameters, or speculative claims removed from baseline assertions.
epistemic_standards.REQUIRES_EXPERIMENT: Formally posed research candidates and variants requiring isolated closed-loop campaign testing.

verified_baseline_facts.ebr_window_horizon_shrinkage: EBR window is range(t, min(t+6, 24)). For t <= 18, 6h window (75,652 Wh). Shrinks at horizon edge: t=19 (63,043 Wh), t=20 (50,435 Wh), t=21 (37,826 Wh), t=22 (25,217 Wh), t=23 (12,609 Wh).
verified_baseline_facts.terminal_target_application: Applied at t=23 as max(EBR[23], terminal_target_wh) = max(12,609 Wh, 100,000 Wh) = 100,000 Wh in Arm B-100.
verified_baseline_facts.priority_hierarchy: J1 (Critical Deficit, P4) >> J2 (Reserve Shortfall, P3) >> J3 (Diesel Fuel, P2) >> J4 (Curtailment, P1).
verified_baseline_facts.forcing_mechanism: Because J2 >> J3, HiGHS strictly forces s_J2 = 0 before minimizing fuel, compelling step-0 diesel dispatch when forecast renewables are low.
verified_baseline_facts.terminal_ablation_evidence: Terminal removal across 6 origins yielded -14.6% fuel (-56.6 L) and -10.2% curtailment, but +6.3% unmet load (+20.2 kWh).

primary_research_candidate.name: Forecast-Conditioned Net-Critical-Deficit EBR
primary_research_candidate.core_research_question: Can a forecast-conditioned net-critical-deficit EBR reduce unnecessary diesel commitment relative to unconditional EBR while preserving critical-load reliability?

solar_input_specification.controller_processing: Consumes electrical PV power in Watts directly. Does NOT compute 51 * I or apply 60 kW cap inside controller. The 51 W/(W/m²) mapping is a campaign adapter prototype, not an authorized physical constant.

critical_demand_specification.vector_definition: critical_demand[k] = min(11600.0, demand.point[k]) for each k in 0..23
critical_demand_specification.nature: Dynamic 24-step vector capped at 11.6 kW, NOT a scalar constant.

reserve_floor_specification.controller_formula_floor: None. No extra additive or max() reserve floor is added to the EBR formula.
reserve_floor_specification.governed_physical_battery_floor: E_min = 40,000 Wh remains enforced by GAP19 physical busbar constraints (E_t >= E_min).

variants.description: Credits forecasted solar generation only against 6h critical demand; zero wind credit in reserve sizing.
variants.formula_t_0_to_22: E_EBR_S[t] = (1 / eta_dis) * sum_{k=t}^{min(t+5, 23)} max(0, critical_demand[k] - solar_generation_point[k]) * dt
variants.formula_t_23: E_stage2_target[23] = max((1 / eta_dis) * max(0, critical_demand[23] - solar_generation_point[23]) * dt, E_term_target)
variants.properties: Unaffected by wind forecast error in reserve sizing (wind remains active in busbar balance). Reverts to governed unconditional EBR when forecast solar is zero across the entire window.

variants.description: Credits forecasted solar and point forecasted wind against 6h critical demand.
variants.formula_t_0_to_22: E_EBR_SW[t] = (1 / eta_dis) * sum_{k=t}^{min(t+5, 23)} max(0, critical_demand[k] - solar_generation_point[k] - wind_generation_point[k]) * dt
variants.formula_t_23: E_stage2_target[23] = max((1 / eta_dis) * max(0, critical_demand[23] - solar_generation_point[23] - wind_generation_point[23]) * dt, E_term_target)
variants.synthetic_wind_warning: Campaign wind series is synthetic (4500 + 5000*sin(2*pi*t/24 + phi)); Variant SW results constitute synthetic-wind research evidence and cannot be generalized to real wind forecasting. Substantively replicates prior critical-aware experiment.

delisted_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Cap formula lacks lower clamp, causing negative values and mathematical infeasibility on 53/173 origins; cap below reserve forces s_J2 > 0 and increases diesel under J2 >> J3.
Requires modifying GAP19 objective code; lambda derivation mathematically refuted; requires future parametric Pareto sweep.
Attribution corrected (68.4% is total EBR-OFF fuel reduction); non-linear for t >= 1 without big-M; lacks verified equipment start-delay model.

Candidate_2_Variant_S.diesel_reduction_mechanism: Releases reserve during daytime solar hours
Candidate_2_Variant_S.safety_risk: Low in reserve sizing (zero reliance on wind forecasts)

Candidate_2_Variant_SW.diesel_reduction_mechanism: Releases reserve during solar & wind hours
Candidate_2_Variant_SW.safety_risk: Medium-High (vulnerable to wind over-forecast; synthetic wind)

Candidate_4_State_Triggered_JIT.diesel_reduction_mechanism: Inhibits diesel when battery energy is safe

governed_validation_protocol.evaluation_dataset_characterization: Pre-specified paired historical evaluation set; not a pristine holdout.
governed_validation_protocol.diagnostic_origins_status: REJECTED for primary testing due to selection bias and small sample size.
governed_validation_protocol.terminal_target_status: FROZEN at 100 kWh to ensure strict causal isolation.

arms.description: Frozen Arm B-100 (governed 6h unconditional EBR, 100 kWh terminal target)
Candidate 2, Variant S (solar credit only, 100 kWh terminal target)
Candidate 2, Variant SW (solar + synthetic wind credit, 100 kWh terminal target)

critical_first.formula: served_crit = min(D_crit, S_total), unmet_crit = D_crit - served_crit, R_crit = 1 - sum(unmet_crit)/sum(D_crit)

proportional.formula: served_crit = served_total * (D_crit / D_realized), unmet_crit = D_crit - served_crit, R_prop = 1 - sum(unmet_crit)/sum(D_crit)
proportional.flat_approximation_note: 82.284510% is an approximation only, NOT an authorized baseline

statistical_testing.origin_pairing: Paired origin-by-origin comparison across all 123 origins
statistical_testing.confidence_intervals: 95% BCa bootstrap confidence intervals for Delta fuel and Delta critical reliability
statistical_testing.hypothesis_testing: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test for paired differences

acceptance_criteria.primary_objective: Statistically significant reduction in total diesel fuel relative to Control (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank two-sided p < 0.05 and BCa 95% CI strictly below 0).
safety_gates: Hard SOC Safety: Zero realized SOC < 20.00% across all 123 origins
acceptance_criteria.safety_precedence_invariant: A candidate failing either reliability convention or the SOC gate is rejected regardless of fuel savings.

governance.production_integrity_verification: GAP19 solver and Causal NWP forecaster integrity are verified strictly by SHA-256 cryptographic hashes. Git diff is not relied upon because untracked repository artifacts exist.
